Full summary: Developed the field-response plan (docs/plans/2026-08-23-field-response-plan.md, uncommitted, review artifact published) via three ultracode workflows: 10-lane investigation with live probes of published builds 2.6.0/2.13.0/2.15.0 plus worktree-built HEAD, 6-lane adversarial verification, plus the earlier response-state audit. Headline: D15 flips from concession to correction — the field's reopening rests on our memo's ambiguous promote-post invariant (post fires only when promoted.length>0, so one post is exactly the two-call prediction), and their creation-time mirror/db divergence hypothesis is refuted by measurement on four builds, byte-identical sync-layer code, and their own found post's detail field. Plan slots all surviving asks into W2/W3/W4 plus a new W5 and DD-11; five rulings requested from Dave before execution.
Decisions: Chose to answer D15 as refuted-with-concession rather than accept the field's reopening — the memo's invariant phrasing and mis-specified escalation criterion are conceded as our fault, but the corrected invariant (verified by measurement on 2.6.0/2.13.0/2.15.0/HEAD and source at all four) makes their one-post evidence confirm the two-call disposition; the earlier drafted retraction language accepting the reopen is SUPERSEDED by this — invalidated if the field's original promote response payload turns out to show promoted:[id] alongside already_active:[id], which would select the duplicate-id single-call mechanism instead (dispositions unchanged either way).; Chose to slot the lineage reverse-scan fix into W2/2.17.0 and ship the field's ask 3 as a write-time createSuperseding transaction that explicitly does NOT defend against ingest reverts — their observed damage is the ingest-revert mechanism governed by the named-open DD-8 file-wins decision, which stays untouched; alternatives of patching precedence opportunistically or declining ask 3 outright were rejected (the txn still closes a real crash window and tightens mirror export pairing).; Chose accept-with-migration for routing proposal 1 using the corrected composition root=gitRootOf(cwd)??cwd then base=resolveWorktreeMain(root)??root — the field's own sketch mis-handles subdir-of-worktree because resolveWorktreeMain does not walk up; warn-phase rides W3, default flip goes to a new W5/2.20.0 gated on quiet notices, preserving W3's single-behavior-change bisection property. Adversarial verify established the July decision 01KY68QN70W0RRWCNMWH57WNEW is doc-placement only, so this is recorded as a NEW decision superseding the project-root.ts header comment and #46's premises, not a supersession of that decision.; Chose to merge routing proposals 2+3 with the planned S1-F item into one W3 'store identity + routing honesty' bundle (resolution trace, created flag, out-of-repo warning reworded to the real creation-at-cwd rule, store_id in config.yml, expect_project with created:true refusal, echo through both toolResult AND toolError) with a pre-agreed 2.18.1 relief valve — store_id and the echo never split because echoing a bare basename reopens the ambiguity our own store demonstrates (config.yml project_name is literally '.').; Chose design-doc-first for routing proposal 4 as new DD-11 designed jointly with DD-6 and DD-4 — measured facts: 21 of 39 tools mutate, no MCP annotations exist, the right seam is an unconditional pre-handler registerTool wrapper, and the Gate-2 failure mode is commit-denial not deadlock (TWINING_DISABLED bypass exists, stop hook self-releases); enforcement lands W5 at the earliest, with only the role observability echo riding W3.; Chose three separate response docs in one send batch (F2 unamended + new wave2-verification response + new routing response) over amending F2 or consolidating — lane convention is one response per inbound thread, nothing in DOC A contradicts F2, and the send must not wait for code because DOC A's archive condition needs acknowledgment only and the field's two amnesia stores remain armed; GitHub filing of all four routing issues recommended but separately Dave-gated as an irreversible public action.; Chose to leave the plan doc uncommitted pending Dave's review (precedent: the read-audit plan) and published the review artifact instead — the five rulings in plan §7 are the blocking inputs before Workstream A executes.
